page.overview:
Who is Ortega?

Ortega (オルテガ Orutega) is a minor character from the Street Fighter series.

Ortega is the director of CIA and an old friend of Mr. Masters since college. When Ken Masters is kidnapped by Shadaloo, Mr. Masters contacts Ortega for assistance. Ortega contacts the Pentagon to call two commandos (Guile and Nash) and gives them the secret mission of investigating Ken's last known position to find and rescue him.

An unnamed member of Interpol resembling Ortega assists Chun-Li and Guile against Shadaloo. Category:Male Characters Category:Street Fighter II V Characters Category:Non Video Game Characters Category:Characters Category:Street Fighter II The Animated Movie Characters
